items.source: Abstract implementation of the EmbeddingModel interface that provides dimensions calculation caching.
items.translation: EmbeddingModel接口的抽象实现，提供维度计算缓存功能。

items.source: Get the number of dimensions of the embedded vectors.
items.translation: 获取嵌入向量的维度数量。

items.source: Return the dimension of the requested embedding generative name.
items.translation: 返回请求的生成式嵌入名称的维度。

items.source:
Return the dimension of the requested embedding generative name. If the generative
name is unknown uses the EmbeddingModel to perform a dummy EmbeddingModel#embed and
count the response dimensions.
items.translation: 返回请求的嵌入生成名称的维度。如果该生成名称未知，则使用 EmbeddingModel 执行一次虚拟的 EmbeddingModel#embed 操作，并统计响应结果的维度。

items.source:
Get the number of dimensions of the embedded vectors. Note that by default, this
method will call the remote Embedding endpoint to get the dimensions of the
embedded vectors. If the dimensions are known ahead of time, it is recommended to
override this method.
items.translation: 获取嵌入向量的维度数量。请注意，默认情况下，此方法会调用远程 Embedding 端点以获取嵌入向量的维度。如果已知维度，建议重写此方法。
dimensions 接口 EmbeddingModel 中

items.source: embeddingModel - Fall-back client to determine, empirically the dimensions.
items.translation: embeddingModel - 用于通过实证方式确定维度的备用客户端。

items.source: modelName - Embedding generative name to retrieve the dimensions for.
items.translation: modelName - 嵌入生成名称以检索其维度。

items.source: dummyContent - Dummy content to use for the empirical dimension calculation.
items.translation: dummyContent - 用于经验维度计算的虚拟内容。
克里斯蒂安·茨洛夫，乔什·朗

items.source: Returns the embedding dimensions for the modelName.
items.translation: 返回指定模型名称的嵌入维度。

items.source: the number of dimensions of the embedded vectors.
